items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And Dave Kapp took my selections, we got a single record that I made for at the time that he was into this kind of thing.

ctx.x: Right. And I got the date because I had a fan whose father knew Dave Kapp very well. They played cards together, and so he talked to Dave Kapp about getting me a date. And Dave Kapp took my selections, we got a single record that I made for at the time that he was into this kind of thing.

And he took it home with him and played it. And asked his black maid, did that do anything for her, and she says, yeah, that's great. And so I got a date. Otherwise, I wouldn't have got the date. At 9:00 in the morning they gave us a date.
